palette.buttonHint: Command palette (Ctrl+K or ⌘K, or the / key)
palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command: follow VER, lap 30, x4…
palette.examples: Try “follow NOR”, “lap 7 of VER”, “1:02:30”, “x4”, “next sc”, “pit NOR” or “next overtake”.
palette.rules: Fixed rules, no AI: understands English and Spanish, ignoring accents and case.

cmd.driverUnknown: No data: no driver “{q}” in this session

pause.title: Pause
pause.detail: Stops playback at the current moment

time.title: Go to {clock}
time.detail: Moves playback to {clock} on the session clock
time.outside: Outside the session: the clock runs from {from} to {to}

relative.atEnd: Already at the end of the session
relative.atStart: Already at the start of the session

select.title: Select {driver}
select.detail: {name} · telemetry in the panel, camera unchanged

overview.title: Overview
overview.detail: Stops following the car; it stays selected

jump.pitDetail: {driver} enters the pit lane (clock {clock}) and gets selected

sc.none: No data: no safety car in this session

vsc.none: No data: no virtual safety car in this session

red.none: No data: no red flag in this session

yellow.none: No data: no yellow flag in this session

chequered.none: No data: no chequered flag in this session

pit.none: No data: no pit lane entry in this session
pit.noneCar: No data: no pit lane entry of {driver} in this session

moment.none: No data: no moment in this session

lap.title: Go to lap {lap}
lap.beyondTotal: No data: the race has {total} laps
lap.noData: No data: no leader laps in this session
lap.noDataMax: No data: leader laps go up to {max}
lap.carOutside: No data: lap {lap} of {driver} starts outside what can be played
lap.carNoStart: No data: unknown start of lap {lap} of {driver}
lap.carNoLaps: No data: {driver} has no laps in this session
lap.carNoLap: No data: {driver} has laps up to {last}
lap.needsDriver: In practice and qualifying each driver has their own laps: type “lap {lap} of VER”
lap.stepNeedsDriver: In practice and qualifying each driver has their own laps: select one or type it (“next lap of VER”)

compare.title: Compare {a} with {b}
compare.needsA: Select a driver first or type both: “compare NOR and PIA”

resume.back: Back to where you left off
resume.backDetail: To the moment resumed when the session opened (clock {clock})
resume.nothing: No position was resumed when this session opened
resume.restartDetail: To the start of the session (clock {clock})
